sentences.text: Kumar Rajratna Bhimrao Ambedkar Medical Assistance Scheme

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals belonging to SC category suffering from incurable & serious diseases. Under this scheme, Medical Assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients diagnosed with life-threatening conditions such as TB, Leukemia, & other critical illnesses.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Health & Wellness; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Kumar Rajratna Bhimrao Ambedkar Medical Assistance Scheme&quot; was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals belonging to Scheduled Caste category suffering from incurable and serious diseases. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients diagnosed with life-threatening conditions such as Tuberculosis (TB), Leukemia, and other critical illnesses.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - Medical Assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients for treatment of incurable and critical diseases like TB, Leukemia, and other serious conditions.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should write the application on plain paper. **Step 2:** Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) along with the application. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the documents to the office of the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Medical Assistance, Disease, Scheduled Caste, Medical Aid, Treatment
